alignments.note: The ASV writes no connective or complementizer for this `כִּי` (*Behold thus shall the man be blessed*), so it is `unrepresented`.
Pual finite verb with its auxiliaries, discontinuous around the subject under rule 25 and headed on the lexical predicate under rule 24.
Subject noun with a supplied definite article, which belongs to the nominal expression it determines under rule 15 since no article morpheme is present.
Articleless attributive recast as a relative clause; the supplied relative joins the attributive's own unit under rule 41 and the unit heads on the word carrying its lexeme.
Rectum of the construct relation, rendered as the bare object of *feareth*.

review_notes: `יְרֵא יְהוָה` → *That feareth Jehovah*: the supplied relative goes with the articleless attributive under rule 41. Rule 46 would place it identically if the participle were read as a substantive in apposition; either reading yields the same unit and head.
